jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Planner
jobs.description:
Overview:

Launch your graduate career in 2027 with Montagu Evans as a Planning Graduate!

  



Montagu Evans is a UK property consultancy that helps clients unlock value from complexity, because that’s where the most meaningful opportunities live.

  

Our purpose is to bring clarity, creativity, and conviction to the complex. We are experts who collaborate to create value, not just preserve it and our team is built for impact, not oversight.

  

We specialise in high\-value, complex assets across the property lifecycle, where political, technical or commercial challenges demand a joined\-up approach.

 **The Team**


Planning is one of the largest departments at Montagu Evans and one of the biggest Planning departments operating in the UK. The role will offer the right Graduate a great career opportunity to work within a busy and growing team. Successful candidates will have opportunities to work in teams for several partners on a variety of projects across Housing \& Land, Commercial and Central London.

  

Graduates gain exposure to projects and colleagues from across all planning groups while collaborating closely with other Montagu Evans specialisms, including advisory, market specialisms, socio\-economics and strategic consulting.

 **Role Overview**  

Our two\-year Graduate Program is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience working directly alongside Partners and other senior colleagues across the business. From day one, your team will value your perspective, give you real responsibility and rely on your contribution. Over the course of your training, your knowledge, skills and experience will grow, preparing you for your Assessment of Professional Competence (APC) with the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) and a successful and rewarding career with us.

  

The structured training programme will allow you to gain experience across a range of project and clients with comprehensive support from peers and mentors. You will have genuine responsibility from day one with exposure to some of the largest commercial, residential and mixed\-use property projects in the UK today. We encourage all our Graduates to explore, question and collaborate across the business.


We invest in our Graduates over two years with the purpose of building long term careers. We offer a market\-leading salary, benefits and lots of opportunities for learning, development and progression.

  

With a keen interest and awareness of property news/industry and the current market, you will be able to demonstrate a great understanding of how you apply what you have learnt at university to real property matters.


Responsibilities:
**Responsibilities**

* Research, analyse and present a range of property data
* Inspect, measure and value a range of property types across the UK
* Appraise property using a range of sector specific valuation software
* Undertake building tours and marketing events
* Attend client meetings, contribute to pitches and presentations, and provide written advice for clients
* Work directly with Montagu Evans Associates and Partners on a day\-to\-day basis
* Liaise and collaborate with various internal departments as well as external consultants (such as architects, solicitors, building surveyors and other agents)
* Enjoy a collaborative ‘can do’ culture where we look to provide a work/life balance through mix of exceptional client service, team socialising and flexible working
* Any additional duties as reasonably requested

Qualifications:
**What We Look For**


We’re not expecting you to know everything on day one \- our Graduate Programme is designed to teach you. What matters most is your potential, your mindset, and your passion for building a career with us.

  



We look for graduates who bring:

* **Academic achievement** – strong academics with an accredited RTPI Degree (essential) or Dual Accredited RTPI and RICS degree
* C**uriosity and ambition**– eager to learn and grow.
* **Fresh ideas** – creative thinkers who challenge the status quo.
* **Collaboration**– team players who thrive on working with others.
* **Strong communication** – clear, confident and professional.
* **Resilience and adaptability** – ready to take on new challenges.
 **What We Offer You**


We invest in our Graduates over two years with the purpose of building long term careers. We offer a market\-leading salary, countless opportunities for learning, development, progression and firmwide benefits including:

* Full ongoing support and training from our Partnership to support you towards gaining your qualification
* 26 days holiday plus bank holidays
* Laptop and mobile phone
* Private Healthcare
* Season Ticket Loan
* Discretionary Bonus
* Employee Assistance Program \& 24/7 GP access
 **Application Process**

**1\. Application Submission**

* Candidates apply via the Montagu Evans website by uploading their most recent CV please note, only applications submitted through the official portal will be accepted.
**2\. Vizzy Profile Completion**

* Candidates will be invited to create a Vizzy profile on https://vizzy.com/ so we can learn more about you as a person, outside of your CV.
**3\. Telephone Interview**

* Selected candidates will have a telephone interview with a member of the Early Careers team.
**4\. Selection Day**

* We will be holding two selection days on Tuesday 8th and Wednesday 9th December 2026\. Successful candidates will be invited to attend one of these days, in\-person. Please ensure before applying that you will be available to attend this day as there will be no other opportunities to be assessed.
* Details about the day will be shared with successful candidates in advance
 **Important Information**


Applications close **5pm Friday 23th October,** with applications being reviewed throughout. Please keep an eye on your emails for next step emails.

jobs.description:
### **About The Role**

**Job Title:** Assistant Planner (Graduate) – Northern Ireland  

  

  

**DIVISION**:Interior Fit\-Out  

**LOCATION**:Northern Ireland  

**CONTRACT TYPE:**Permanent  

**BENEFITS**:Car Allowance; Subsidised Private Medical Cover; Life Assurance Scheme; Living away from home allowance (where appropriate), Contributory Pension, 35 Days annual leave (Including Public Holidays)  

  

  

**Job Summary**  

At GRAHAM, we are committed to developing future talent. As our Interior Fit\-Out Division continues to grow, we have an exciting opportunity for an Assistant Planner to join our team in Northern Ireland.  

As a Graduate Planner, you'll gain valuable hands\-on experience supporting the planning and delivery of fast\-paced fit\-out and refurbishment projects across a range of sectors. Working alongside experienced Planners, Project Managers, and site teams, you'll develop your understanding of how projects are programmed, coordinated, and successfully delivered from inception through to completion.  

This role offers an excellent opportunity to build on your academic studies through practical project experience, structured development, and mentoring from experienced professionals. You'll develop technical, digital, and problem\-solving skills while gaining exposure to industry\-leading planning tools and construction methodologies.  

If you're passionate about construction, technology, and project delivery, this is an excellent opportunity to build a rewarding career with GRAHAM.
  

**Job Description:**  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Support the Planning Team in analysing tender information and preparing tender programmes.
* Assist with the development and maintenance of project master programmes.
* Support the analysis of labour, plant, and resource requirements.
* Assist in the evaluation of construction methods, sequencing, and delivery strategies.
* Support the preparation of project preliminaries, procurement schedules, and information release schedules.
* Assist in monitoring project progress and the performance of subcontractor packages against programme milestones.
* Attend and contribute to client meetings and collaborative subcontractor planning workshops.
* Support the coordination, distribution, and communication of project programmes to key stakeholders.
* Maintain planning records, progress updates, and production control information.
* Work closely with project teams to identify risks, opportunities, and programme improvements.
* Contribute to the effective day\-to\-day operation of the Planning Department while developing planning knowledge and skills.


  

This job description is intended to give the post holder an appreciation of the role envisaged and the range of duties to be undertaken.  

It does not attempt to detail every activity. Specific tasks and objectives will be agreed with the post holder at regular intervals.  

  

**Requirements:**  

**Technical Competencies**  

**Essential**  

* Degree qualified (or due to graduate) in Construction Management, Architectural Technology, Construction Engineering, Project Management, or a related built environment discipline.
* Strong communication and organisational skills.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Interest in developing a career within construction planning and project delivery.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Right to work in the UK.
* Full UK Driving Licence.


  

**Desirable**:  

* Previous placement, internship, or work experience within the construction industry.
* Understanding of construction or interior fit\-out projects.
* An appreciation of Health \& Safety practices.
* Experience using planning or project management software, such as Microsoft Project, Asta Powerproject, or Primavera P6\.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


  

**Behavioural Competencies**  

**Essential**  

**Commercial Awareness:** show willingness to build a strong business acumen combined with the creativity and vision to meet customer needs and GRAHAM business requirements.  

Effective Communication skills: Able to adapt communication to audience and create detailed written documents and reports. Able to maintain and manage communication links with a variety of stakeholders. Presents a professional image and promotes the Brand.  

**Customer Focus:** Takes time to question and understand the real, underlying needs of the customer, beyond those initially expressed. Always works closely with customers, developing an independent view of their needs and acting in their long term interest  

**Influencing:** Identifies and builds relationships with those who will be useful now and in the future in achieving strategic business objectives.  

**Initiative**: is able to work alone to get results in an effective way. Understands and seeks to minimise waste in resources and processes. Adopts and encourages others to adopt new ways of working. Ability to work unsupervised.  

**Team Player:** Always willing to be involved in other activities to achieve company objectives. Works collaboratively and uses influence to gain resolution of issues. Demonstrates honestly, loyalty and commitment.  

**Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate with both subcontractors and representatives of the Employer to ensure all contractual rights and obligations are realised and protected  

  

**About You**  

**GRAHAM ROUTES TO BECOMING A PLANNER**  

**GRADUATES**  

We offer a two year programme which focuses on developing your technical and interpersonal skills. In addition, a structured, mentored training programme, aligned to a recognised professional qualification, will set you on the pathway to chartership. Through early responsibility you’ll learn quickly on challenging projects with the opportunity for fast track career advancement.

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.


Your impact  

  

Join the Jacobs Graduate Development Program (GDP) and help shape better environments, communities and societies. Bring your passion, creativity and ambition — and together, we’ll create lasting change.

  

  

**What You’ll Get**

  

Our two‑year Graduate Development Program is designed to accelerate your growth as you begin your Jacobs career. Through blended learning, mentoring, progress reviews and networking, you’ll build capability across four key areas: human skills, consulting skills, championing our strategy, and developing your personal passions.

  

  

You’ll tailor your learning journey to your interests, career goals and technical strengths — creating a graduate experience that’s uniquely yours. Much of your development will come through real project work, supported by your manager and mentor to ensure you gain the experiences that matter most.

  

  

The Graduate Development Program isn’t just a steppingstone — it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain the tools, exposure and support to unlock your potential, working on meaningful projects and collaborating with industry leaders to deliver solutions to complex challenges.

  

  

**About the opportunity**

  

  

In Cities \& Places and Major Programmes, we deliver today’s most complex, challenging and iconic infrastructure and transformation programmes. We work with our clients, across multiple sectors, to unlock better social, environmental and economic outcomes. Our dedicated teams have the experience and expertise to integrate and manage the scale, complexity and interdependencies that exist within major programmes. We address global challenges in an integrated way, from urbanisation, climate change, logistics and digital proliferation to security, water scarcity, investment partnerships and mega infrastructure.

  

As a Project Controls \- Planning Graduate, you will learn and develop your skills to enable you to translate project scopes of work into design and/or construction Critical Path Method (CPM) schedules that meet project objectives and address project constraints and risks. You will also you will be able to include the application of earned value (EV) methodologies, regular updates, time impact analysis of changes, and reporting to schedules.

  

  

To enable you to achieve this you will work towards achieving the following:

  

  

* General Career Development
* Client \& Stakeholder Management
* Planning \& Performance
* Risk Management
* Execution: Quality \& Innovation
* Leadership Ability
  

  

The start date for this position is **September 2027\.**


Here's what you'll need  

  

* Be working towards a relevant Degree or Master’s level qualification in Construction, Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science or Mathematics
* A flexible, proactive mindset and motivation to drive your career forward
* Adaptability and enthusiasm for learning
* Permanent right to work in the UK
  

  

**Selection Process**

  

* Apply Online


* Solo Video Assessment


* Interview

  

  

Apply before **12 October 2026** to be considered in the first assessment window. Applications may still be accepted afterwards, but roles may be filled during the initial window.

  

  

For further information, please see our brochure \- https://jacobs\-global.foleon.com/brochures/early\-careers/\

jobs.title: Strategic Planning Consultant
jobs.description:
**At Buro Happold, we are redefining what great cities look like—creating places that are sustainable, inclusive, and resilient. We are now seeking an Strategic Planning Consultant to join our Global Urban Strategies team, playing a key leadership role in shaping city\-scale solutions across the UK and internationally.**


The role will be based from our London office with hybrid working.

  

We are looking for a person passionate about solving the challenges facing cities who has specialist urban and strategic planning skills to join our London based team.


You will have an opportunity to play a role in shaping and delivering projects combining our data analytics and urban modelling with our core strategic advisory, planning, economics, infrastructure and environment capabilities.


You should have 2\+ years post qualification experience. We are looking for a talented urban planner who is a team player and strong project collaborator.

**Required skills**

* Demonstrate an understanding of urban development challenges and the value of providing integrated urban development and strategic planning solutions.
* Excellent problem solver able to interpret and understand the implications of analytical outputs
* Awareness and understanding of what it takes to deliver effective and viable client outcomes in a commercial working environment.
* Ability to liaise with internal and external clients to promote urban and regional development solutions and deliver high quality input into their projects.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable working with quantitative datasets and building clear data\-driven narratives
* Demonstrate an ability to prepare high\-quality reports of a technical nature.

**Specialist technical** and **sector expertise** in one or more of the following areas:

* Strategic advisory for urban plans, programmes and projects
* Preparation of regional and city scale planning frameworks
* Development planning and masterplanning of large\-scale mixed\-use developments
* Data analytics and geo\-spatial analysis
* Understanding of how statutory plan\-making systems work: policy hierarchies, evidence requirements and approval processes and the ability to transfer that thinking into unfamiliar national and regional planning contexts.
* An awareness of the factors that determine whether plans and projects are deliverable, land ownership and assembly, phasing, infrastructure funding, and governance and delivery arrangements and a willingness to develop this understanding.
* Preparation of projects and programmes to support urban development including infrastructure planning and business case for economic, social and green infrastructure programmes and projects.
* Demonstrate strong cultural and institutional awareness, recognising how governance structures, land tenure and delivery mechanisms differ between geographies and shape what is deliverable.
* Competent in GIS (QGIS or ArcGIS) for spatial analysis and the production of publication\-quality mapping;

 **Desirable Skills**

* Familiarity with the UK plan\-making system, including the NPPF, Local Plans and the emerging spatial development strategy regime for strategic authorities.
* Involvement in delivering integrated urban development, strategic spatial planning projects.
* Experience in urban resilience, climate change mitigation and adaptation, strategic environmental management and sustainable development strategies
* Involvement in delivering regional planning, masterplanning and urban design projects
* Working familiarity with CAD (2D and 3D) — in particular georeferencing and converting CAD masterplan, survey and land\-parcel drawings for use in GIS
* Experience using Adobe Illustrator and InDesign, or similar graphics software
* Foreign language skills
* Experience of planning practice in more than one country, or of adapting methodologies developed in one regulatory context for use in another
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and workshops.

 **Qualifications**

* Essential \- Degree in a field allied to strategic urban planning such as geography, town planning, social science, geographic information science, environmental science, or architecture.
* Desirable \- Masters degree in urban planning, spatial planning, urban design, or similar
* Desirable – RTPI chartered or with a clear route to Licentiate/Chartered membership; equivalent international body considered.

 **Role \& Responsibilities**

* Developing tailored consulting technical solutions; delivering an approach that adapts to our clients understanding, experience and needs.
* Undertaking pieces of planning and urban development research to feed into projects.
* Preparation of technical reports and client presentations.
* Engaging with Buro Happold colleagues from other technical disciplines and / or external collaborators to provide integrated reports and solutions for our clients.
* Coordinating inputs from other disciplines into integrated deliverables and maintaining the quality, traceability and internal consistency of project outputs, including comment tracking and client response
* Contributing towards innovation, technical capability and skills development initiatives and programmes.
* Support senior members of the team in preparation of proposals, fee estimates and bid material
* You may be required to work on projects either the UK or overseas as the need requires.
* The post holder must at all times carry out their duties with due regard to the BuroHappold Equality \& Diversity Policy.
* You are required to set a personal example in all aspects of Occupational Health and Safety (OH\&S).
* You are responsible for encouraging and maintaining high standards of OH\&S in all areas under your control; meeting or exceeding targets and reporting on OH\&S Key Performance Indicators. You will ensure compliance with the Company’s health and safety policy, relevant legislation and guidance in these areas.

jobs.title: January 2027 - Retail Development Program - Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
Retail Development Program Overview
  
Belk offers talented and ambitious recent graduates the opportunity to work in multiple areas of our business. The Retail Development Program (RDP) is a fast\-paced three\-month program designed to prepare recent college graduates for a full\-time role at Belk. We offer opportunities in several of our business functions including Merchandising, Planning, Supply Chain and more! The program focuses on key components to support your development: Education, Experience, Exposure, Innovation and Results.
  
  

The Retail Development Program – Planning will hire a class of program participants in our Charlotte, NC headquarters. RDPs are required to move and live in the Charlotte, NC Metro area.
  
  

Planning \- Position Summary
  
The Retail Development Program – Planning prepares you for your first position as an Assistant Planner. The primary responsibilities of an Assistant Planner will include building merchandise financial plans that support the merchandise strategies while achieving corporate financial goals. In addition, you will work independently and partner with the Planner to conduct key business analysis, to maximize profitability. Through our hands\-on learning approach, participants assume job responsibilities quickly while completing a robust learning curriculum. In addition to on\-the\-job learning, participants will engage with a variety of senior leaders across the company, attend networking events and learn from top talent in the business. Planning RDPs are placed within a Buying office to experience the job first\-hand. Participants are also matched with mentors to help acclimate to Belk and develop on the job.
  
  

On the Job

jobs.company: The Town of Pine Knoll Shores
jobs.title: Town Planner
jobs.description:
The Town of Pine Knoll Shores is seeking a motivated and knowledgeable professional to serve as our next **Town Planner** within the Planning and Inspections Department.

Located on North Carolina's beautiful Crystal Coast, Pine Knoll Shores is a unique coastal community dedicated to preserving its natural environment while thoughtfully planning for the future. This position offers an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact on land use planning, community development, and floodplain management.

**Position Summary**

The Town Planner performs professional planning work involving land development review, zoning administration, GIS mapping, code enforcement, floodplain management, and long\-range planning initiatives. The position serves as a key resource for residents, contractors, developers, boards, commissions, and government agencies regarding local planning and development regulations.

**Essential Duties Include:**

* Reviewing development applications, subdivisions, rezonings, annexations, site plans, and related projects.
* Preparing reports, ordinances, resolutions, maps, and planning documents.
* Managing and maintaining GIS data and mapping systems.
* Supporting the Planning Board, Board of Adjustment, and Board of Commissioners through research, presentations, and staff reports.
* Serving as the Town's Floodplain Manager and Community Rating System (CRS) Coordinator.
* Assisting with long\-range planning efforts, including land use, transportation, hazard mitigation, and resilience planning.
* Responding to inquiries from residents, contractors, builders, and development professionals.
* Performing code enforcement duties and ensuring compliance with applicable ordinances.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree.
* One to three years of professional planning experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Knowledge of planning principles, zoning regulations, land development processes, GIS applications, and community planning practices.
* Strong communication, public presentation, and customer service skills.
* Ability to interpret surveys, site plans, engineering drawings, and maps.
* Valid North Carolina driver's license or ability to obtain one.

**Why Pine Knoll Shores?**

* Beautiful coastal work environment.
* Opportunity to influence the future of a vibrant beach community.
* Collaborative and professional municipal team.
* Diverse responsibilities spanning planning, GIS, floodplain management, and community development.

Salary \& Benefits

Salary Range: $73,000 – $109,000 DOQ  
Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

Gym Membership  
Training and Development Encouraged  
Collaborative Team Environment

How to Apply

Submit a completed Town employment application, resume, and cover letter to:

Missy Shine, Assistant Town Manager  
Town of Pine Knoll Shores  
100 Municipal Circle  
townclerk@townofpks.com

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.

The Town of Pine Knoll Shores is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay: $73,000\.00 \- $109,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 457(b)
* AD\&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Role \& Responsibilities:**

The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for the support and service delivery for a fast\-growing Software ecosystem with the following key Responsibilities:


* Develop and incubate software strategies and articulate them within a technical and business framework for existing strategic EXFO customers
* Monitor usage analytics to identify underutilization and proactively deliver targeted training and best practices.
* Work closely with product/sales leadership to implement and execute strategies to developing expansion business growth for EXFO’s Platform Ecosystem Solution – SaaS
* Provides system\-level consulting expertise to design performance solutions for named service providers.
* Work cross\-functional with multiple business units and solution teams to leverage existing products and create segment\-specific solutions.
* Responsible for collaborating with delivery services, reviewing scoping and service deal development in partnership with the delivery teams.
* Interface with existing strategic customers to solidify expectations of performance and growth of EXFO’s software Platform end 2 end solutions
* Proactively track customer health data across complex corporate structures to eliminate churn and secure high\-value contract renewals.
* Align EXFO Product Management team with target accounts and engage customers in roadmap decisions to align with upcoming customer requirements
* Coordinate with Product/Sales management teams to align EXFO software Platform end 2 end solutions to the needs of the customers to affect significant process changes that impact customers’ business metrics
* Provide competitive intelligence – feature set, road map, pricing information to product management teams
* Work with BU direction to optimize software solution pricing and offer
* Work closely with sales and BU director at leveraging EXFO’s partner network for the deployment of cloud products and services.
* Identify and attend tradeshows and other business functions to keep abreast of developments in the marketplace, to find potential new business opportunities, and to market Solution
* Create an effective annual business plan that directly supports the strategic and financial goals of the business
* Work closely with sales, marketing, development, customers and prospects to set the software strategic direction and overall product positioning
* Planning, developing and working with the marketing communications team on the execution and sustainment for all elements of software go\-to\-market initiatives: product launches, market research \& analysis, outbound messaging, value propositions, differentiation and thought\-leadership communications activity
* Ensuring that technological resources meet the company's short and long\-term needs.
* Outline the goals for research and development.
* Creating timelines for the development and deployment of all technological services.
* Acting as a mentor to team members while training key sales members on the software technology.

**Requirements:**

* Working knowledge of cloud\-based solutions and applications
* Understanding of engineering data pipelines, cloud\-based analytics, and common test frameworks or automation scripting tools. Deep familiarity with Test \& Measurement workflows, hardware validation and automated test equipment.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, strong business acumen and collaborative skills with internal/external business partners and customers
* Minimum 3 years of customer success, technical account management, or application engineering experience handling complex, multi\-site B2B accounts.
* Excellent communication skills to lead strategy and development of new business pitches and presentations
* Prioritization and alignment of multiple goals and objectives
* Maturity and comfort level interacting with senior executives both internally and externally
* Self\-starter with the ability to communicate and interact with people at all levels, including executive levels, both external and internal to EXFO
* Strong planning, organizational and prioritization skills
* Demonstrates strong judgment and analytical skills
* Innovative problem solver

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in information technology.


**Experience:** Minimum of 3 years in Customer Success role, technical account role or similar position handling complex multi\-site B2B accounts.


EXFO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Urban Planner – City of Spartanburg, SC
jobs.description:
**City of Spartanburg, South Carolina**


**Position:** Senior Urban Planner


**Job Summary**: The City of Spartanburg is seeking a motivated, collaborative, civic\-minded professional to contribute to our expanding Planning Department. The individual in this role will have the opportunity to help shape the future of a city on the rise. Spartanburg is in the midst of an exciting transformation, with more than $800 million in public and private investment downtown creating new energy, new places, and new possibilities throughout the community. This is a chance to be part of that momentum—to bring ideas forward, build meaningful partnerships, and help shape a city that is more connected, vibrant, and welcoming. As part of a dedicated team, the Senior Planner plays a central role in planning, zoning, and development initiatives that shape Spartanburg’s future. The position supports implementation of the Comprehensive Plan, administration of the Zoning Ordinance (currently being updated), and special development projects, while serving as a liaison to one of the City’s four planning boards


**Salary Range:** DOQ – Starting at $67,500


**Additional Information** can be found here
